html:
Chunking

Splitting long documents into retrievable passages while preserving needed context.

In practice

A refund rule and its custom-order exception can land in separate chunks. Preserve headings, source positions and useful overlap.

What to check

Inspect the resulting chunks. Tables, code and exceptions need appropriate boundaries; tune size and overlap for the documents and queries.

Common confusion

Smaller is not always better. Overlap increases indexed and input content and cannot preserve every dependency.
